newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SEES LUCENT VENTURE IN OP PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SEES LUCENT VENTURE IN OP PROFIT.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it saw an earlier announced joint venture with Lucent Technologies of the U.S. as being in operational profit from October 1 this year.
"We think it will be generating operational profit from the first of October," a spokeswoman for Philips told Reuters.
The spokeswoman said the 60/40 merger, between Philips Consumer Communications (PCC) and Lucent's consumer products business, was expected to be in place by October.

"We will be immediately number one world leader in corded, cordless phones, answering machines (with the venture) and of course we will significantly strengthen our capabilities in the wireless arena," the spokeswoman said.
"We are merging with the complete Lucent Tecnology consumer business, which means we will have a jointly owned venture with a combined turnover of $2.5 billion a year."
Philips spokeswoman Angelique Paulussen said the new venture would be headquartered in New Jersey under the leadership of PCC managing director Mike McTighe.
"The products of the joint venture will be sold under the Philips brand name," she said.
"We see very little duplication in product lines," McTighe said in a statement. "This company will hit the ground running this holiday season, delivering more than 40 new products," he added.
Philips Chairman Cor Boonstra said in a statement the businesses were complementary, not only in regional terms but in product range and distribution channels.
"We will be able to achieve a position as world wide player much faster than both partners could have done on their own," he said.
"This combination will enable us to go for growth in the consumer communications market and to share a wealth of opportunities a core strategic area for the Philips Group," he added.
